settings.title: I stare at the screen and cannot start
settings.body: The task is there, but beginning feels unusually difficult.

settings.title: My attention keeps disappearing
settings.body: You switch constantly, check automatically, or cannot stay with one thing.

settings.title: My thinking feels foggy
settings.body: Thoughts feel slow, unclear, or harder to organise than usual.

settings.title: I used to be sharp. Something changed.
settings.body: A noticeable change in attention or cognition is worth taking seriously.

settings.heading: When focus has become hard to find.
settings.body: Distraction, brain fog, difficulty starting, and a noticeable cognitive change may need different routes. Begin with what you can observe rather than trying to label yourself.
settings.note: Focus difficulties can have many causes. Mirellis does not diagnose ADHD, cognitive decline, burnout, or another condition from a webpage.
